chapter: New Orleans ballrooms and Tony Almerico
title: Dancers and acts at Almerico's club, the dancing waiter Joe
summary: They recall acts at Almerico's club, including a white waiter Joe who danced with a tray, and wonder where Pork Chops and Kidney Stew performed.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah, yeah. Well, anyway, we're getting away from Tony. Did he have dancers then? We talked about him. I can remember. We talked about Lizzy. And of course, Frank would get out and do his act. I don't remember any dances at that time.

Yeah. What was his son-in-law's name? Louis Mitro. D'Amico or something like that. He had a waiter that danced. Joe or something or another. Golly, I'm digging way down deep. He was the doorman at the show bar and is now a dancer. He would go up and work to the freezing room as a waiter on Sunday. And I saw Joe. Joe's got to be my age or maybe a couple of years older. And he went to show bars. And I can remember Joe standing up in front of the 500. Oh, who was the actor and the comedian at the 500? And Joe knew his entire routine. And while he was standing outside, he used to lip sync his routine with this guy. But I think he danced. He would do like a jazz dance because he could do a split with the tray, hold the tray and do the split down to the floor and come back up.
This is a white guy. Yeah. Was it Black Joe who danced? No, no, he was a white guy. And he's still alive you think.
Yeah, oh I saw him a couple of years ago. And he had his little grandson used to dance every once in a while. But I'm trying to think that pork chops and kidney stew come up there.
They may have, but I associate them with Sharky, but they could have been doing it. They could have been working different places.
Yeah, it's confusing. It seems to me that I knew pork chops and kidney stew, but I can't remember now if it was from the Parisian room or from with Sharky's thing.
Or strolling up and down the street. Could have been. From one place to another. And there was a lot of that going on too.
Yeah. Yeah they used to go from club to club.
